det.korean: ② revising → revised: version은 수정되는 대상(수동)이므로 과거분사 revised가 적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ② revising(수정하는): 능동 의미. version은 수정된 것(수동)이므로 revised가 올바름
✅ ① raised(제기된): points raised by reviewers — 수동 관계로 적절
✅ ③ incorporating(반영하는 것): 동명사 주어로 적절
✅ ④ claims(주장): 복수 명사로 적절
det.tip: revised version(수정된 버전) — 과거분사가 명사를 수식(수동 관계)

det.analysis:
✅ ③ be accepted: 수동태 (원고가 수락되다) — will 뒤 병렬 구조
❌ ① accept: 능동태인데 주어가 manuscript이므로 부적절
❌ ② accepting: 진행형이면 be accepting인데 의미상 부자연스러움
❌ ④ have accepted: 능동 완료시제, 주어가 manuscript이므로 부적절
det.tip: will satisfy A and (will) be accepted — 병렬 구조에서 will 생략. 원고는 수락되는 대상(수동)

det.korean: ③ thorough → thoroughly: as ~ as possible 구문에서 부사가 필요. addressing을 수식하므로 부사 thoroughly가 적절.

❌ ③ thorough(형용사): as thoroughly as possible — 동명사 addressing을 수식하므로 부사 thoroughly 필요
✅ ① is: 주어 this에 맞는 동사
✅ ② in: cooperation in ~ing (전치사 in)
✅ ④ evaluated: have + 과거분사(현재완료)
det.tip: as + 부사 + as possible = 가능한 한 ~하게 / thorough(형) → thoroughly(부)

We understand that this is a busy time, but as the revision deadline of your manuscript (December 27th) is quickly approaching, we kindly ask for your cooperation in addressing the reviewers' comments as thoroughly as possible within the limited time available. The reviewers have carefully evaluated your manuscript and provided insightful and critical feedback. To help you revise, we have summarized the key points raised by both reviewers. Please review these comments carefully and submit a revised version of your manuscript. We are confident that incorporating these suggestions will significantly improve the manuscript and provide stronger support for your main claims. We hope that the revised manuscript will satisfy the reviewers and be accepted in our journal. Thank you for your attention and cooperation.
questions.stem: "The editor asked the author to address only one reviewer's comments." (T/F)

det.korean: 원문은 "the key points raised by both reviewers"(두 리뷰어)라고 했으므로, 한 명의 리뷰어만이라는 내용은 거짓.
det.analysis:
❌ False: both reviewers(두 리뷰어 모두) ≠ only one reviewer(한 명의 리뷰어만)
원문: "summarized the key points raised by both reviewers"
det.tip: both(둘 다) vs only one(한 명만) — 수량 표현 정확히 대조
